full_prompt_en: A square slice-of-life anime illustration shows a smiling schoolgirl from the chest up against a clear cyan-blue background. Her head tilts slightly toward the viewer's left. Short dark bangs fall in uneven pointed strands across her forehead, while the rest of her nearly black hair forms a rounded cap around the crown. Two long dark braids descend at either side of her shoulders, each tied near the ear with a broad red-orange ribbon. She looks outward with oversized oval eyes, dark brown irises, small white highlights, a tiny nose mark, and a delicate closed-mouth smile. A faint peach blush warms both cheeks. Beneath the face, a white collared blouse has softly puffed sleeves and a small gathered detail at the throat. Vivid red-orange pinafore straps cross the shoulders and join a broad bodice at the lower edge of the frame. Simple folds and muted brown-red shadows give the garment just enough volume. The girl fills most of the frame, with the round dark hair mass contrasting clearly against the flat bright backdrop. A few translucent circles float near the corners and left edge, their thin pale outlines and soft white glints reading as soap bubbles. The drawing uses smooth dark contours of moderate weight around the face, hair, braids, and clothing; finer broken lines describe separate bangs and fabric creases. Color is clean and mostly flat, with small gentle gradations in the skin and blue field. Soft frontal light brightens the cheeks, eyes, and white blouse while gray-violet shadows settle under the chin and in the hair. The limited cyan, charcoal, warm peach, white, and vermilion palette gives the image a buoyant school-day mood. A light speckled surface softens the digital color without distracting from the large expressive eyes and uncomplicated composition.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形日常动画插画表现一名从胸口以上入画、站在清亮青蓝色背景前微笑的女学生。她的头微微向观者左侧倾斜。深色短刘海以参差的尖束垂在额前，近乎黑色的其余头发在头顶形成圆润发块。两条深色长辫子沿肩两侧垂下，靠近耳朵处各扎一枚宽宽的红橙色蝴蝶结。她以放大的椭圆眼睛望向外侧，深棕色虹膜里带细小白色高光，鼻子只是一个小笔点，嘴角形成轻轻闭合的笑。两颊有淡淡的蜜桃色红晕。脸下是一件白色翻领衬衫，袖子柔和地鼓起，领口处带一个小小的收褶细节。鲜明的红橙色背带跨过双肩，在画面下缘接入宽大的连身裙胸片。简洁衣褶和偏棕红的浅阴影赋予布料适度体积。女孩几乎占满画框，圆形深色发块与平坦明亮的背景形成清楚对照。几个半透明圆圈浮在角落和左侧边缘，细淡轮廓与柔和白色反光让它们像肥皂泡。绘图以中等线重的流畅深色轮廓勾出面部、头发、辫子和衣物，较细且断续的线条区分刘海和布褶。上色洁净且以平涂为主，皮肤与蓝色区域只有小幅柔和渐变。正面的柔光照亮面颊、眼睛和白衬衫，灰紫阴影落在下巴与头发深处。青蓝、炭黑、暖桃色、白色和朱红的有限配色，带来轻快的校园日常气息。细微颗粒轻轻柔化数字色面，不抢走大眼睛和简明构图的注意力。
style_prompt_en: Use gentle slice-of-life anime drawing with rounded silhouettes, expressive simplified features, and smooth dark contours of moderate weight. Keep the design legible through a large central dark shape, a few bright warm accents, and a broad clean cool field behind it. Favor flat color blocks with only slight tonal transitions in skin and background; place compact gray-violet shadows beneath overlapping forms to retain soft volume. Draw eyes as clear oval shapes with small reflective highlights, while reducing noses, mouths, and fabric details to economical marks. Add a few translucent outlined circles or other airy graphic motifs sparingly to activate negative space. Limit the palette to cyan, charcoal, creamy white, warm peach, and red-orange. Soft frontal illumination, restrained blush tones, and faint surface grain create a friendly, lightly printed quality. Let asymmetry in hair strands and small folds bring life without crowding the simple composition.
style_prompt_zh: 采用温柔的日常动画绘法，以圆润剪影、简化而传神的五官和中等线重的流畅深色轮廓为基础。用居中的深色大形、少量明亮暖色强调和背后宽阔洁净的冷色区域维持可读性。上色偏向平涂，只在肌肤与背景加入轻微色调过渡；重叠处放置紧凑的灰紫阴影，保留柔和体积。眼睛画成清楚椭圆并点上小反光，鼻口与衣物细节则收束为节省的笔迹。稀疏地加入半透明描边圆形或其他轻盈图形元素，活化留白。将颜色限制在青蓝、炭黑、奶油白、暖桃色和红橙色。柔和正面光、克制红晕及微弱表面颗粒形成亲切的轻印刷质感。让发丝的不对称和少量衣褶增加生气，同时保持构图简洁。
theme_en: A smiling schoolgirl with braided hair against a blue field of bubbles
theme_zh: 扎辫子的微笑女学生置于飘着泡泡的蓝色背景前
name: Azumanga Daioh
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
